name: What is the process for assessing and planning pathway safety improvements?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for assessing and planning pathway safety improvements?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process typically begins with a professional assessment of your existing pathways. This involves identifying hazards such as cracks, uneven surfaces, poor drainage, insufficient lighting, and obstructive landscaping. Following the assessment, a detailed plan is developed outlining recommended repairs, material choices, and a proposed timeline. This plan considers local building codes and your specific safety goals. Once approved, the contractor schedules the work, coordinates materials, and begins the improvement project.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process starts with a professional assessment to identify hazards, followed by a detailed plan outlining repairs, materials, and a timeline. Work begins after approval.
